people.name: Maximilian von Weichs
people.nameZh: 馬克西米利安·馮·魏克斯

heading.en: Origins, training and the First World War

body.zh-Hant: 韋希斯1881年11月12日生。1900年7月他以士官候補生身分進入巴伐利亞第2重騎兵團，1910至1913年在慕尼黑軍事學院受訓，並進入總參謀部工作。1914年2月升任騎兵大尉，一戰期間先後擔任傳令軍官、高級副官，自1915年5月起為總參謀軍官，始終在西線。
body.en: Weichs was born on 12 November 1881. In July 1900 he entered the Bavarian 2nd Heavy Cavalry Regiment as an officer cadet and studied at the Munich War Academy in 1910–13, which led him into General Staff service. He became a Rittmeister in February 1914 and served in the First World War as orderly officer, senior adjutant and, from May 1915, General Staff officer, always on the Western Front.

citations.quote: im Juli 1900 als Fahnenjunker in das Kgl. Bayer. 2. Schwere-Reiter-Regiment
Kriegsakademie in München (1910–13)
Rittmeister Febr. 1914
als Ordonnanzoffizier, höherer Adjutant
seit Mai 1915 als Generalstabsoffizier durchgehend an der Westfront

body.zh-Hant: 1920年4月，韋希斯參與鎮壓魯爾區的共產黨起事。1933年12月他以少將身分接掌威瑪的第3騎兵師，該師1935年改編為德國第一個裝甲師；其間1935年4月升中將，1936年10月升騎兵上將。1937年10月起任紐倫堡第8軍軍長，1939年10月出任第2集團軍司令。
body.en: In April 1920 Weichs was used in suppressing the communist uprising in the Ruhr. In December 1933, as a major general, he took over the 3rd Cavalry Division in Weimar, which was converted into the first German panzer division in 1935; he was promoted lieutenant general in April 1935 and General of Cavalry in October 1936. From October 1937 he commanded VIII Army Corps in Nuremberg, and in October 1939 he became commander-in-chief of the 2nd Army.

Aufstands im Ruhrgebiet eingesetzt

im Okt. 1939 Oberbefehlshaber der 2. Armee

heading.zh-Hant: 第2集團軍與歐洲各戰役
heading.en: The 2nd Army and the campaigns in Europe

body.zh-Hant: 韋希斯的部隊參加了波蘭戰役（包括布祖拉河戰役與攻佔華沙）、法國戰役，以及南斯拉夫戰役（攻佔薩格勒布與貝爾格勒）。1941年7月起他在蘇聯作戰，所屬第2集團軍在「巴巴羅薩行動」中參與了比亞韋斯托克、基輔與布良斯克的包圍戰。
body.en: His formations fought in the campaigns in Poland (the Battle of the Bzura and the capture of Warsaw), France and Yugoslavia (the capture of Zagreb and Belgrade). From July 1941 he fought in the Soviet Union, where, in Operation Barbarossa, his 2nd Army took part in the encirclement battles of Białystok, Kiev and Bryansk.

citations.quote: in den Feldzügen in Polen (Schlacht an d. Bzura, Einnahme v. Warschau)
Jugoslawien (Einnahme v. Zagreb u. Belgrad)
seit Juli 1941 in der Sowjetunion
Im „Unternehmen Barbarossa“ beteiligte er sich mit der 2. Armee
an den erfolgreichen Kesselschlachten von Białystok, Kiew und Brjansk

heading.en: Army group commander and field marshal

body.zh-Hant: 1942年7月，韋希斯在東線第二次夏季攻勢中接掌B集團軍群，史達林格勒的慘敗即發生在該集團軍群轄下。1943年2月希特勒仍晉升他為元帥；自1943年8月至1945年3月，他同時擔任東南方面軍總司令與F集團軍群司令。1944年秋季自希臘與南斯拉夫的撤退成功，被推測是他最大的軍事成就。
body.en: In July 1942, during the second summer offensive in the east, Weichs took over Army Group B, within whose ranks the Stalingrad catastrophe occurred. Hitler nevertheless made him a field marshal in February 1943, and from August 1943 to March 1945 he served simultaneously as Commander-in-Chief South-East and commander of Army Group F. The successful withdrawal from Greece and Yugoslavia in autumn 1944 was presumably his greatest military achievement.

citations.quote: übernahm W. im Juli 1942 die Führung der Heeresgruppe B
in deren Verband sich die Katastrophe von Stalingrad ereignete
ernannte Hitler ihn im Febr. 1943 zum Generalfeldmarschall
von Aug. 1943 bis März 1945 als Oberbefehlshaber Südost
gleichzeitig Oberbefehlshaber der Heeresgruppe F
Der gelungene Rückzug aus Griechenland und Jugoslawien im Herbst 1944 war
vermutlich W. s größte militärische Leistung

body.zh-Hant: 1945年5月起，韋希斯成為美軍戰俘。他在紐倫堡軍事法庭對東南將領的審判（第7案）中被起訴，但在1948年11月判決前因病獲釋。
body.en: From May 1945 Weichs was an American prisoner of war. He was indicted before the Nuremberg Military Tribunal in the trial of the south-east generals (Case 7) but was released because of illness in November 1948, before the verdict.

citations.quote: Seit Mai 1945 in amerik. Kriegsgefangenschaft
vor dem Nürnberger Militärtribunal gegen die Südost-Generale (Fall 7) angeklagt
im Nov. 1948 wegen Krankheit entlassen

heading.zh-Hant: 第3騎兵師與第1裝甲師的建立
heading.en: From the 3rd Cavalry Division to the 1st Panzer Division

body.zh-Hant: 1934年韋希斯調任威瑪第3騎兵師師長。1935年恢復徵兵後，該師改編為第1裝甲師，由他建軍至1936年；1936年10月1日他晉升騎兵上將。
body.en: In 1934 Weichs was transferred to Weimar as commander of the 3rd Cavalry Division. After conscription was reintroduced in 1935 the division became the 1st Panzer Division, which he built up until 1936; on 1 October 1936 he was promoted General of Cavalry.

citations.quote: Versetzung als Kommandeur der 3. Kavalleriedivision nach Weimar
die 1. Panzerdivision, die Weichs bis 1936 aufbaut
1. Oktober: Beförderung zum General der Kavallerie

heading.zh-Hant: B集團軍群與史達林格勒

body.zh-Hant: 1942年7月，布洛克去職後，韋希斯接掌新編成的B集團軍群。該集團軍群須守住從史達林格勒到沃羅涅日、長達800公里的戰線。11月20日蘇軍反攻開始，他察覺危險；第6軍團隨後被劃出B集團軍群，改隸新成立的頓河集團軍群。1943年夏他下令縮短戰線，7月10日被調入元首預備隊。
body.en: In July 1942, after Bock's dismissal, Weichs took over the newly formed Army Group B, which had to hold an 800-kilometre front from Stalingrad to Voronezh. When the Soviet offensive began on 20 November he recognised the dangers; the 6th Army was then detached from Army Group B and assigned to the newly formed Army Group Don. In summer 1943 he ordered a shortening of the front, and on 10 July he was transferred to the Führer Reserve.

people.nameZhOrig: 马克西米利安·冯·魏克斯

heading.en: The First World War and the interwar years

body.zh-Hant: 哈里斯在第一次世界大戰中曾擔任第45與第44中隊的隊長；戰間期他的工作地點在中東與印度。丹麥《Lex》此條未寫出這些職務的起迄日。
body.en: Harris commanded Nos. 45 and 44 Squadrons in the First World War and was employed in the Middle East and India in the interwar years. The Lex entry does not give start or end dates for these posts.

citations.quote: I 1. verdenskrig var han chef for eskadrillerne 45 og 44
I mellemkrigsårene var han beskæftiget i Mellemøsten og Indien

heading.zh-Hant: 第5轟炸機大隊與轟炸機司令部

body.zh-Hant: 二戰爆發時，哈里斯被任命為第5轟炸機大隊（No. 5 Bomber Group）指揮官，1941年晉升空軍中將。1942年2月他出任皇家空軍轟炸機司令部司令，其嚴厲的領導作風使他在報界被稱為「轟炸機哈里斯」，在部屬之間則被稱為「屠夫哈里斯」。
body.en: At the outbreak of the Second World War Harris was appointed head of No. 5 Bomber Group and in 1941 was promoted to Air Marshal. In February 1942 he became head of RAF Bomber Command, where his harsh leadership style earned him the nicknames "Bomber Harris" in the press and "Butcher Harris" among his personnel.

citations.quote: Ved udbruddet af 2. Verdenskrig udnævntes han til chef for No. 5 Bomber Group
blev i 1941 forfremmet til Air Marshal
I feb. 1942 blev han chef for RAF 's Bomber Command
"Bomber Harris" (i pressen) og "Butcher Harris" (hos personellet)

body.zh-Hant: 哈里斯與副手羅伯特·桑迪空軍少將（Robert Saundby）從一開始就主張以地毯式轟炸、集中大批空軍兵力打擊選定的大城市，來摧毀德國的戰爭努力。隨著飛機損失增加、預期的士氣與生產崩潰沒有出現，批評漸增。他仍與美國陸軍航空軍合作，於1945年2月13／14日轟炸德勒斯登，這次空襲成為戰爭末期對轟炸機司令部批評最大的事件。
body.en: Together with his deputy, Air Vice-Marshal Robert Saundby, Harris pressed from the start to break the German war effort by carpet bombing, committing large air forces against chosen major cities. As aircraft losses rose and the expected collapse of morale and production failed to appear, criticism mounted. He nevertheless carried out the bombing of Dresden on 13/14 February 1945 in cooperation with the USAAF, and this raid became the most criticised event of Bomber Command's work at the end of the war.

citations.quote: Han lagde sammen med sin næstkommanderende, air vice-marshal Robert Saundby
at knække den tyske krigsindsats gennem tæppebombardementer
et stigende tab af fly og udeblivelsen af det ventede moralske
bombningen af Dresden 13/14. feb. 1945
Ikke mindst dette angreb blev genstand for den største kritik

body.zh-Hant: 1945年9月哈里斯離開皇家空軍，1946年被任命為皇家空軍元帥。他是戰後唯一沒有被封為貴族上院議員的軍方最高首長，因此於1948年遷居南非，直到1953年邱吉爾替他爭取到從男爵頭銜。
body.en: Harris left the RAF in September 1945 and was appointed Marshal of the Royal Air Force in 1946. He was the only top military chief not made a peer immediately after the war, which led him to move to South Africa in 1948, where he stayed until Churchill secured a baronetcy for him in 1953.

citations.quote: efter sin afgang fra RAF i sept. 1945
Marshal of the Royal Air Force (i 1946
Han blev derimod den eneste militære topchef
i 1948 at flytte til Sydafrika
Churchill i 1953 fik udvirket

heading.zh-Hant: 轟炸機司令部的區域轟炸作戰與德勒斯登空襲
heading.en: Bomber Command's area-bombing campaign and the Dresden raid

body.zh-Hant: 哈里斯出任轟炸機司令部司令後，與副手羅伯特·桑迪空軍少將從一開始就採取地毯式轟炸，以大批空軍兵力打擊選定的大城市，意在摧毀德國的戰爭努力。丹麥《Lex》指出，與美軍白天針對軍需目標的轟炸不同，哈里斯認為大片工人住宅區與工廠同樣是重要的轟炸目標。的結果看來令人鼓舞，但飛機損失增加，預期中德國士氣與生產的崩潰並未出現，批評因而漸增。1945年2月13／14日，他與美國陸軍航空軍合作實施德勒斯登轟炸，這場轟炸戰役中，這次空襲成為戰爭末期對轟炸機司令部批評最大的事件。
body.en: After taking command of Bomber Command, Harris and his deputy Air Vice-Marshal Robert Saundby pursued carpet bombing from the outset, using large air forces against selected major cities in order to break the German war effort. Lex notes that, unlike the American daytime raids aimed directly at war-important targets, Harris regarded the large working-class housing districts as just as important targets as the factories. The results seemed encouraging at first, but rising aircraft losses and the absence of the expected collapse of German morale and production led to growing criticism. On 13/14 February 1945 he carried out, together with the USAAF, the bombing of Dresden, which became the most criticised episode of Bomber Command's work at the end of the war.

citations.quote: tæppebombardementer med indsættelse af store luftstyrker mod udvalgte storbyer
citations.claimSpan: 哈里斯與桑迪採地毯式轟炸打擊選定大城市

body.zh-Hant: 威爾遜1864年5月5日生於愛爾蘭朗福郡的埃奇沃斯敦。《牛津英國史指南》指出，他在英國軍人中是少見的親法派，也喜歡與政客往來；1910至1914年他擔任陸軍部軍事行動處長，負責擬定一旦對德開戰就把英國陸軍送往法國的計畫。
body.en: Wilson was born on 5 May 1864 at Edgeworthstown, County Longford, Ireland. The Oxford Companion to British History notes that he was unusual among British soldiers in being an ardent Francophile who enjoyed the company of politicians; between 1910 and 1914 he was Director of Military Operations at the War Office, preparing plans to send the British army to France in the event of war with Germany.

body.zh-Hant: 大戰爆發後，威爾遜在法國擔任各種聯絡職務；1915年獲封巴斯勳章騎士指揮官（K.C.B.）。1918年2月，勞合·喬治解除威廉·羅伯遜的職務，由威爾遜接任帝國總參謀長；但首相很快抱怨這位新顧問和前任一樣，主張把英軍主力部署在西線。
body.en: When the war came, Wilson served in a variety of liaison posts in France; he was made a K.C.B. in 1915. In February 1918 Lloyd George dismissed Sir William Robertson and Wilson succeeded him as Chief of the Imperial General Staff, but the prime minister soon complained that his new adviser was as committed to deploying the bulk of the British army on the western front as his predecessor had been.

body.zh-Hant: 威爾遜1919年被封為男爵（Baronet）。1922年他自陸軍退役，並於2月21日在北唐郡（Down North）補選中當選下議院議員，所屬政黨為聯合黨（Unionist）；同年6月22日他在倫敦家門口被愛爾蘭共和軍刺殺，議員任期因死亡結束。
body.en: Wilson was created a baronet in 1919. In 1922 he retired from the army and was elected on 21 February, in a by-election for Down North, as a Unionist Member of Parliament; on 22 June 1922 he was murdered on his own doorstep in London by the IRA, which ended his term through death.

body.zh-Hant: 《牛津英國史指南》（David French撰）指出，威爾遜在1910至1914年任陸軍部軍事行動處長期間，負責擬定一旦對德開戰就把英國陸軍送往法國的計畫。大戰爆發後，他在法國擔任各種聯絡職務；1918年2月接替遭首相勞合·喬治解職的威廉·羅伯遜出任帝國總參謀長。該條目寫到，首相很快抱怨這位新顧問和前任一樣，主張把英軍的大部分兵力部署在西線。條目未列出威爾遜參與的具體戰役，因此本段只記來源明載的作戰計畫與兵力部署主張。
body.en: The Oxford Companion to British History (by David French) states that while Director of Military Operations at the War Office between 1910 and 1914, Wilson prepared plans to send the British army to France in the event of war with Germany. When war came he served in a variety of liaison posts in France, and in February 1918 he succeeded William Robertson, whom Prime Minister Lloyd George had dismissed, as Chief of the Imperial General Staff. The entry says the prime minister soon complained that the new adviser was as committed to deploying the bulk of the British army on the Western Front as his predecessor had been. The entry names no specific battles in which Wilson took part, so this paragraph records only the operational planning and force-deployment stance that the source states.

body.zh-Hant: 亞倫·根寧咸1887年5月1日出生，父親是大衛·根寧咸教授。他在切爾滕納姆就學，後入伍利奇皇家軍事學院，1906年受任軍官，並參加第一次世界大戰。1919至1921年擔任海峽殖民地的參謀軍官，1925年通過海軍參謀學院。
body.en: Alan Cunningham was born on 1 May 1887, the son of Professor D. J. Cunningham. He was educated at Cheltenham and the Royal Military Academy, Woolwich, was commissioned in 1906 and served in the First World War. He was a General Staff Officer in the Straits Settlements in 1919–21 and passed the Naval Staff College in 1925.

body.zh-Hant: 1928年他晉升名譽中校，1928至1931年擔任機槍學校教官。1937年進入帝國國防學院，同年起擔任第1師皇家砲兵指揮官，至1938年；1938年晉升少將，並指揮第5防空師（領土軍）。
body.en: He was brevet lieutenant-colonel in 1928 and instructor at the Machine Gun School in 1928–31. In 1937 he attended the Imperial Defence College and was commander Royal Artillery of the 1st Division in 1937–38; in 1938 he became a major-general and commanded the 5th Anti-Aircraft Division (Territorial Army).

body.zh-Hant: 1940年他先後指揮第66、第9與第51師；1940至1941年任東非部隊總司令，1941年任中東第8帝國軍總司令，並於同年獲封KCB。1942年任坎伯利參謀學院院長，1943年晉升中將，1943至1944年任北愛爾蘭司令，1944至1945年任東部司令部總司令。
body.en: In 1940 he commanded the 66th, 9th and 51st Divisions; he was GOC East Africa Forces in 1940–41 and GOC-in-C of the 8th Imperial Army in the Middle East in 1941, and was made KCB in 1941. He was Commandant of the Staff College, Camberley, in 1942, became a lieutenant-general in 1943, was GOC Northern Ireland in 1943–44 and GOC-in-C Eastern Command in 1944–45.

body.zh-Hant: 1945年他晉升上將，1945至1948年擔任巴勒斯坦高級專員兼總司令，1948年獲頒GCMG。牛津聖安東尼學院中東中心所藏其文件涵蓋該任期的官方文件與電報，主題包括非法移民、惡化的治安、英美調查委員會與聯合國巴勒斯坦特別委員會（UNSCOP）、以及英軍撤離的準備。
body.en: He became a full general in 1945, was High Commissioner and Commander-in-Chief for Palestine in 1945–48 and received the GCMG in 1948. The collection of his papers at the Middle East Centre, St Antony's College, Oxford, holds official papers and telegrams from this period, covering illegal immigration, the deteriorating security situation, the Anglo-American Committee of Enquiry, UNSCOP and preparations for the British withdrawal.

heading.en: Security operations and withdrawal planning in Palestine

body.zh-Hant: 根寧咸1945至1948年任巴勒斯坦高級專員兼總司令期間，牛津大學聖安東尼學院中東中心所藏文件顯示，其任內處理的事務包括1946年的「阿加莎行動」（Operation Agatha）材料，以及1948年3至4月的巴勒斯坦軍事情勢說明，並有同年4月海法阿拉伯人與猶太人衝突的報告。文件主題另涵蓋英美調查委員會、聯合國巴勒斯坦特別委員會（UNSCOP），以及英軍撤離的準備工作。該檔案說明只列文件主題，未寫出作戰過程與結果，也未列其早年東非或北非的戰役；那些部分來源未載，本段不加推測。
body.en: Papers held by the Middle East Centre, St Antony's College, Oxford, show that during Cunningham's tenure as High Commissioner and Commander-in-Chief for Palestine (1945–1948) he dealt with material relating to Operation Agatha in 1946, a statement on the military situation in Palestine for March–April 1948, and a report on Arab-Jewish clashes in Haifa in April 1948. The papers also cover the Anglo-American Committee of Enquiry, the United Nations Special Committee on Palestine (UNSCOP) and preparations for the British withdrawal. The archive description lists only document topics: it does not describe the course or outcome of operations, nor his earlier East African or North African campaigns, which the source does not cover and this paragraph does not speculate about.

body.zh-Hant: 伊恩·漢密爾頓生於科孚島，當時其父所屬的第92戈登高地團駐防該地。他就讀惠靈頓學院，之後入伍，加入父親原來的團。他的軍旅生涯包括派駐愛爾蘭、印度與南非。
body.en: Ian Hamilton was born in Corfu, where his father's regiment, the 92nd Gordon Highlanders, was stationed. He attended Wellington College and then entered the British Army, joining his father's old regiment. His military career included postings to Ireland, India and South Africa.

heading.en: Colonial wars and the Russo-Japanese War

body.zh-Hant: 他參加過第二次英阿戰爭（1878至1880年）與兩次波耳戰爭（1880至1881年、1899至1902年），也參與過救援喀土穆戈登將軍的遠征（1884至1885年）。日俄戰爭期間（1904至1905年），他以印度軍代表身分隨日本帝國軍隊行動。
body.en: He fought in the second Anglo-Afghan War (1878–80) and in both Boer Wars (1880–81 and 1899–1902), and took part in the unsuccessful expedition to relieve General Gordon at Khartoum (1884–85). During the Russo-Japanese War (1904–05) he was attached to the Japanese Imperial forces as representative of the Indian army.

heading.zh-Hant: 加里波利戰役與地中海遠征軍
heading.en: Gallipoli and the Mediterranean Expeditionary Force

body.zh-Hant: 漢密爾頓最後的現役指揮職是1915年的地中海遠征軍總司令，任務是支援海軍，強行通過達達尼爾海峽以壓制鄂圖曼帝國。澳洲戰爭紀念館指出，加里波利行動的指揮權交給了他，但他不適合這場需要強勢領導的戰役；八月的攻勢失敗後，他的指揮受到檢討。10月15日他被撤換，繼任者查爾斯·門羅將軍建議撤退，這也實際上結束了他的軍旅生涯。
body.en: His last active command was in 1915 as General Officer Commanding the Mediterranean Expeditionary Force, under orders to support the fleet in neutralising the Ottoman Empire by forcing a passage through the Dardanelles. The Australian War Memorial says command of the Gallipoli operations was given to him but that he was ill-suited to a campaign demanding strong leadership; after the August attempts to regain the initiative failed, his command came under scrutiny. On 15 October he was replaced, and his successor, General Charles Monro, recommended evacuation; it was effectively the end of his military career.

body.zh-Hant: 漢密爾頓1920年自陸軍退役，之後投入退伍軍人組織：1932至1947年擔任南非戰爭退伍軍人協會會長，1925至1947年擔任蘇格蘭英國軍團會長。
body.en: After retiring from the army in 1920, Hamilton became involved in ex-servicemen's organisations: he was president of the South African War Veterans Association (1932–47) and president of the British Legion in Scotland (1925–47).
